init.title: NIBE Local REST API options
init.description: The whole points table (about 1 MB) is read at the update interval. Points chosen under fast polling are additionally re-read on their own, one small request each, which is useful for values that move quickly, for example compressor frequency, additional heat steps or power.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the full points table is read.
data_description.fast_points: Leave empty to switch fast polling off. Only points that have an enabled entity are listed.
data_description.fast_interval: Each round sends one request per chosen point. Keep it at 5 seconds or more; the heat pump's API is slow.
